definitions.explanation: Being younger than others, especially within a group such as a family, class, or team. Often used attributively with の or in compounds.

examples.japanese: {年少|ねんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{子|こ}ども。
⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧{年少|ねんしょう}だ。
examples.english: My younger brother is three years younger than me.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{最|さい}{年少|ねんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}した→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: The youngest player on the team performed well.

notes:
USAGE: {年少|ねんしょう} means younger or junior in age, most often used attributively with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or inside compounds. It is the antonym of ⟦{年長|ねんちょう}→年長：29601_nenchou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年少|ねんしょう}{組|ぐみ}: the younger group (e.g. in kindergarten)
- {年少|ねんしょう}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: a younger/junior person
- {最|さい}{年少|ねんしょう}: the youngest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{年下|としした}→年下：07303_toshishita⟧: younger — the everyday, colloquial word for someone younger
- ⟦{年長|ねんちょう}→年長：29601_nenchou⟧: older, senior — the direct antonym
